title: Assessing a model provider: security, data residency and contracts

videos.script: Every prompt the assistant builds leaves for a company Tarefa does not run. Its practices become Tarefa's. {{title}} So the questions are written first, before anybody reads a sales page. Some are lines Tarefa will not cross. Others only count in a provider's favour. {{list}} Three invented providers answer. The one with the best score is out, because it reports an incident after Tarefa's own deadline has passed. {{out}} Another is out because it trains on customer data unless told not to. A clause in the contract could change that. {{clause}} The third passes. But its two most important answers rest on nothing except its word. {{claims}} So those answers go into the contract before anybody signs. And the whole list is run again every year, and whenever the terms change. {{again}}
